d:
The song captures the voice of a true gangster delivering a stern warning to a wannabe trying to meddle in his affairs. With raw intensity and an authoritative tone, the track lays down the reality of crossing paths with someone who’s lived the life and earned their stripes. It’s a powerful message: stay out of my business, or be prepared to face the consequences.
